observable_behaviors: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.
Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.
Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.
Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.
Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

rules.name: Known outage first
rules.rule: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.

rules.name: Diagnose before ticket
rules.rule: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.

rules.name: No coverage promises
rules.rule: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.

rules.name: Handset limits
rules.rule: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.

forbidden_actions: Raising a ticket without a diagnostic.
Quoting a restoration time no tool returned.
Promising better coverage as an outcome.

rules.name: Catalogue truth
rules.rule: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.

rules.name: Postpaid cycle
rules.rule: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.

rules.name: No benefit invention
rules.rule: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.

rules.name: Balance before recharge
rules.rule: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

forbidden_actions: Quoting a plan, price or benefit the catalogue did not return.
Promising an immediate postpaid plan change.
Recommending a recharge without reading the current state.

Data bahut slow chal raha hai.
Ghar ke andar bilkul signal nahi aata.
Koi plan hai jisme OTT free mile?

Validity kab tak hai? Number band to nahi hoga?

apply_recharge.purpose: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

check_network_status.purpose: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

list_plans.purpose: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

lookup_subscriber.purpose: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

raise_network_ticket.purpose: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

run_line_diagnostic.purpose: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

verify_customer_identity.purpose: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

network_complaint.purpose: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
network_complaint.business_context: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

terminal_success_conditions: Ticket raised with an id and the tool's resolution window conveyed.
Subscriber told a known outage covers them and given its ETA.
escalation_conditions: Subscriber reports a safety-critical inability to call emergency services.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments

recharge_and_plan.purpose: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.
recharge_and_plan.business_context: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

terminal_success_conditions: Recharge or migration applied with a transaction id and the effective date stated.
Subscriber told why the change cannot take effect now.
escalation_conditions: Subscriber disputes a charge from a previous cycle.

valid_tool_sequence_patterns.note: the verification's result must justify the action's arguments
